decisions.reason: The count of remaining board markings does not change the required power-board BOM or manufacturing-export package.
The source does not change the sensor-board BOM, Gerber, drill-file, or pick-and-place requirements.
The remaining board markings are independent of resolving missing components in the main-board manufacturing package.
Adding identification marks does not alter component availability, sourcing, alternatives, or assembly-part checks.
The number of remaining board marks has no effect on the requirement that every board use lead-free assembly.
Board markings do not change the task of reviewing component orientations on the manufacturing platform.
The source does not change account access, cart setup, board upload, or manufacturing-platform checks.
Identification markings do not alter the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel count, placement, or current coverage.
The mark count does not change the enclosure's board count, battery accommodation, or mechanical capacity.
The remaining board markings do not alter the required JST GH connector count.
The source does not change the LED count, model, package, part number, or other LED-array attributes.
Board identification marks are a separate requirement and do not necessarily alter the main board's dimensions, component placement, connector arrangement, or mechanical layout.
